issue.title: Bug: Sync Now triage — claim queue hardening + metadata error visibility
issue.body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #469 (BibleText ID identity). Sync Now can still look "broken" for reasons other than wrong `bibleTextId`:

1. Pending claim sync can abort the whole metadata sync or drop queue rows on ambiguous API responses.
2. Sync page surfaces upload chrome but not metadata step failures from `useSync` (`SYNC_ERROR_*` / `displayText`).
3. Silent chapter-assignment FK skips can leave My Work empty while sync "succeeds".
4. Residuals of #428 / #177 should be verified, not re-implemented wholesale.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pending claim sync: do not delete queue rows on ambiguous API responses; do not abort entire metadata sync on a single claim failure without clear Sync-page surfacing.
- [ ] Sync page shows metadata step failures from `useSync` (`displayText` / `SYNC_ERROR_*`), not only upload chrome.
- [ ] Verify residuals of #428 / #177; log or surface silent chapter-assignment FK skips if they still starve My Work.
- [ ] Unit / hook tests for the new Sync page metadata error path and claim-queue hardenings.

## Out of scope

- #469 BibleText ID identity (handled separately).
- #152 notification chrome, #256 conflict tokens, #271 claim-conflict product UX, #257 stage queue.

## Related

- Refs #469 for the upload identity fix.
- Discord #mobile discussion (Roslin / Chad Sync Now blockers).
